test_knn_fsdp: test the TestKNNBenchmark class and run KNN benchmark with FSDP pretraining and feature extraction
run_knn_at_layer: run KNN classification on a specified model layer and return top-1 and top-5 accuracy scores
run_knn_at_layer_low_memory: run low-memory KNN classification on a specified model layer for large-scale feature evaluation
create_pretraining_config: create a Hydra pretraining configuration for SWAV with FSDP or standard regnet model setup
create_extract_features_config: create a Hydra feature extraction configuration from a checkpoint for trunk or head layer features
